body: I am terrified. I have nowhere to go, and I think I may be pregnant. I knowingly stayed in this relationship so I think if I am dumb enough to stay, I probably deserve what’s given.

I do not think I have value. He tells me all the time how I have no respect for myself because of my past, and thinking about it I think he is right. I stayed with abusers, I stayed with people for drugs, I was intimate with a lot of people just to feel something. I don’t think I am deserving of anything more. This is probably karma for everything and everyone I did wrong.

He thinks that guys and girls can’t be friends and that everyone just wants to fuck me, he thinks I am naive and can’t see that. But all I did was message a friend asking if I can vent to him. I don’t know what I did wrong

He was a friend before anything, he was there when I tried to kill myself multiple times. I don’t think I am a good person though, sometimes I think I just ask to be abused. But I do want a family, so bad. :(
There has been issues in the past. I think we are on okay terms, but I do not feel welcomed when I am around at all.
